name: MidLC common saturation
description: Thins every library by binomial sampling to the same depth relative to its own complexity: the group's smallest depth-to-MidLC ratio. MidLC is the depth at which a library is expected to show half of its occupied sites. Downsampling only; counts stay whole numbers.
formula: MidLC_j: sum_s[1-(1-p)^c_sj] = occupied_j/2, MidLC_j = p*total_j; p_j = min_group(total/MidLC) * MidLC_j / total_j; counts ~ Binomial(c, p_j)
may_suit: Comparing libraries sequenced to different saturation, and essentiality inputs that should not depend on sequencing depth.
caution: Discards reads (random, seeded); the most saturated libraries lose the most. Does not correct insertion-site preference or skew. Units are thinned reads, not a common scale.
